title: 彭博记者：中国万字白皮书反击产能过剩指控
speaker: Min Min Lo

segments.en: Yeah, it's a very long 10,000 character position paper and really hitting back again so what China is calling hyped up claims of Chinese overcapacity.
segments.zh: 是的，这是一份长达万字的立场文件，再次回击了所谓中国产能过剩的夸大说法。

segments.en: So if you look at the data, China's industrial utilization rate was down about 73% in the second quarter. If you can pull up that chart, it is the lowest level since 2020 during the lockdown period.
segments.zh: 从数据看，中国二季度工业产能利用率降至约73%，是2020年封锁期以来的最低水平。

segments.en: But China is saying that this is not an accurate indicator because different countries, different sectors have different utilization rate.
segments.zh: 但中方认为这并非准确指标，因为不同国家、不同行业的利用率各不相同。

segments.en: And it's side examples of how the U.S. and EU also run surpluses in areas like pharmaceuticals, like chips and airplanes and it doesn't mean that it's excess capacity, right?
segments.zh: 并举例美欧在药品、芯片、飞机等领域也存在顺差，但这并不意味着产能过剩。

segments.en: And it's saying that in this case China's trade surpluses is really because of its strong tech advancements, efficient supply chain as well as of course global demand.
segments.zh: 文件指出，中国的贸易顺差源于技术进步、高效供应链以及全球需求。

segments.en: It also hit back at these accusations of state subsidies saying that China has made attempts to make it more transparent. It's been working with local governments to climb down on improper incentives, for example.
segments.zh: 文件还反驳了政府补贴的指控，称中国已努力提高透明度，并与地方政府合作减少不当激励。

segments.en: And this is of course coming at a sensitive time because we are running up against that October deadline when the EU and Brussels is supposed to reset their trade ties with China.
segments.zh: 这正值敏感时期，因为欧盟将在10月截止日期前重新调整对华贸易关系。
